# Paragraph structure

> **这页管什么**：一段一个意思，要点放段首。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/paragraph-structure> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## One idea per paragraph

Each paragraph tackles a single idea in the fewest words and the fewest sentences possible. Don't split a paragraph that covers just one idea, even if it's long.

## Length

- Paragraphs longer than **5 or 6 sentences** often signal the content is trying to do too much.
- If too long, break it up or remove content.
- Single-sentence paragraphs are acceptable.
- A paragraph longer than six sentences can be fine if it stays focused on one idea.
- Don't artificially stretch sentences to reduce sentence count — use shorter sentences *and* shorter paragraphs.

## Critical information placement

**Put the most important information at the start of a paragraph.** Don't bury the key point at the end — readers don't read every word.

## Formatting

- Left-align text. Don't center, full-justify, or right-align.
- Avoid manual line breaks within sentences or paragraphs — they render badly across devices, window sizes, and text scaling.

## Rationale

Scannability of the page, and avoiding dense blocks of text.
